text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, ibuprofen is not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 211 tablets of 400 mg (15.3 days on hand). Corvale General holds 580 tablets of 400 mg (30.2 days) and 439 tablets of 600 mg (23.1 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 64 tablets of 400 mg (11.3 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include ibuprofen as of 2026-10-21. The rule-based check found no FDA shortage posting and no qualifying plant action before a posting at a registered plant.

Our position: Current inventory covers immediate needs at all sites, though Corvale Lakeside has the lowest days on hand at 11.3 days. The buyer should verify current allocation and contract terms with the primary supplier.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer verifies allocation and contract terms with the primary supplier; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer evaluates purchasing from Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC as the top-ranked alternate; requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer evaluates purchasing from Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC as the second-ranked alternate; requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer evaluates purchasing from AiPing Pharmaceutical, Inc. as the third-ranked alternate; requires buyer approval.
5. Buyer evaluates purchasing from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC as the fourth-ranked alternate; requires buyer approval.
6. Buyer evaluates purchasing from Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC as the fifth-ranked alternate; requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
